_: Which loc each room type is shown by in poh_roommenu. There is no room model in the
cache - OSRS draws these rows from sprites - so each room borrows the model of a loc
that stands in it. Chosen by rendering every candidate (tools/ifrender.py) and looking:
wall decorations (the quest hall map, the dartboard) render edge-on and were dropped,
and so were the low wide tables, which at a 26-degree pitch are a band and nothing else.
The zoom is NOT here: tools/ifmodels.py solves it from each model's own geometry.
